description: Record a traversal path as useful for a problem type. Lighter than save_crossing — no synthesized insight required, just the path and what kind of work it helped with. Traces accumulate: visible as trace_count on connections in traverse() output. Higher trace_count edges get a scoring boost in consult(), so frequently-useful paths surface faster for future agents working on similar problems.

path.description: Ordered sequence of piece IDs traversed (minimum 2)

productive_for.description: Brief description of the problem type this path helped with

name: record_trace
